tools.name: watchlist_list
tools.description: A page of the watchlist, oldest entry first, optionally of one group. Each entry tells whether its initial check is done (checked_at) and whether it is within the limit of the plan (monitored).

tools.name: watchlist_remove
tools.description: Remove one entry from the watchlist; name its group if it has one.

tools.name: events_list
tools.description: Events for the watchlist after a cursor, oldest first: bankruptcies, compositions, debt enforcement, liquidations, deletions, register deficiencies and changes, and new entries published in the Swiss Official Gazette of Commerce (SHAB), each with a link to the notice and its signed PDF. tools.name: webhook_create
tools.description: Add a webhook endpoint (https on a public address, at most 5): every new event of the chosen kinds (default: all) is posted to it as JSON, signed with HMAC-SHA256 in the UIDWatch-Signature header. The signing secret is returned only in this answer.

tools.name: webhook_list
tools.description: The webhook endpoints of the account with their kinds.

tools.name: webhook_delete
tools.description: Delete a webhook endpoint; no more events are posted to it.

tools.name: webhook_test
tools.description: Post a sample event marked "test": true to a webhook endpoint now and tell how it answered (10 per minute).

tools.name: account_status
tools.description: The account: plan (trial, monitor or paused), whether the list is monitored, the limit and usage in entries, the end of the trial, whether the email address is confirmed, and last_scan_at, the last successful check of the gazette.

tools.name: billing_checkout
tools.description: A Stripe Checkout link for the subscription: CHF 33 per month per package of 2500 entries, 1 to 10 packages, cancel monthly. A person, or an agent with its own payment method, opens the link and pays there.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: uidwatch_signup, account_status · Private data: uidwatch_signup, webhook_create · Public sink: uidwatch_signup, webhook_create, webhook_list, webhook_delete, webhook_test, account_status · Destructive: watchlist_remove, webhook_delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: uidwatch_signup, account_status · Private data: uidwatch_signup, webhook_create · Public sink: uidwatch_signup, webhook_create, webhook_list, webhook_delete, webhook_test, account_status · Destructive: watchlist_remove, webhook_delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
